Racing Zip Jacket & Sunglasses

Sporty, sharp, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The contrast panels and racing graphics are the defining details.
- Keep the graphics generic to avoid text in the image.
Try this: Keep the racing graphics generic, without readable text.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, windswept
brown hair wears wraparound black sunglasses
and a black and gray racing-style zip jacket with a
funnel neck, contrast side panels, and embroidered
racing graphics. A black shoulder bag hangs from
one shoulder, and black cargo trousers with a belt
complete the look. Her expression is calm and
confident. A plain white backdrop with soft, even
light. Palette of black, charcoal, and silver. Sporty
and sharp, in the style of a Y2K activewear
lookbook.
